mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_progress(user_id, cet_word_id, consecutive_correct, total_wrong, last_quiz_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{cetWordId}, #{consecutiveCorrect}, #{totalWrong}, #{lastQuizAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE consecutive_correct = VALUES(consecutive_correct), total_wrong = total_wrong + #{totalWrong}, last_quiz_at = VALUES(last_quiz_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consecutive_correct = 0 ORDER BY last_quiz_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM quiz_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cet_word_id = #{cetWordId}
